name: La Veranda Resort Phu Quoc - MGallery Collection
short_description: A 5-star MGallery resort styled after a 1920s French mansion on Duong Dong Beach, Phu Quoc, facing the Gulf of Thailand, holding a 4.9/5 ALL Rating (758 reviews).
ai_summary: La Veranda Resort Phu Quoc - MGallery Collection is a 5-star resort on Duong Dong Beach designed in the style of a 1920s French mansion, facing the Gulf of Thailand. Rooms come with complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs, and room service. The resort has Le Bar for cocktails and business/meeting facilities. It holds one of the highest ALL Ratings among Phu Quoc's Accor properties at 4.9/5 from 758 reviews. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.
